note: Fixture provenance manifest. source=synthesised means the file was shaped from the type definitions and docs in this repo and was NOT recorded from a live server. scripts/fedi-smoke.ts exercises the same endpoints against live rig servers; run it to replace synthesised bodies with recorded ones (each rewrite flips source to recorded with the real recordedAt). Tests must not treat synthesised fixtures as proof of live-server behaviour. Carried from the v1 Keystone repo (frontend/test/fixtures/manifest.json); misskey/sharkey bodies are byte-identical to v1, pinetree bodies are carried verbatim (the four bodies misskey-adapt.test.ts used to inline).
